correctness.rationale: The shore update is exactly zero/one/retain/complement, with symbolic labels that distinguish complementary patterns of equal cardinality. Every real configuration induces one of 80 compatible orders of (a,i,a-i,b,j,b-j), two threshold cuts from 7 and 8 positions. I separately implemented this comparison quotient: all 4480 formal cases satisfy F^6=F^4 and the stated T=4 predicate, with exactly 16 exceptional cases. Independently implemented synchronous labelled-state evolution on 29892 sampled exhaustive-small parameter/state instances found no discrepancy. The quotient, including tied-order overcoverage, is a finite exact proof of all actual order types, not an enumeration cutoff. Summing binomial multiplicities of the two disjoint orientations gives N_4.
